## EMST role: Park ranger (visitor and resource management) (state variant, entry level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:closeMatch`, confidence 0.6, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R21-park-ranger-visitor-resource/state:2640`). *Authority position (editorial):* resource-manager.

**Competency targets at this level (agent draft)**

- Provide visitor information, orientation and safety messaging in parks and protected areas — entry L1 *(distinguishing)*
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — entry L1
- Assess tree risk and structural condition — entry L1
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — entry L1
- Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings — entry L1
- Communicate during field emergencies and report incidents — entry L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1
- Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids — entry L1
- Construct and maintain trails to sustainable design standards — entry L1

**Main tasks at this level (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- Orient visitors at a contact station to routes, conditions, regulations and hazards matched to their plans and abilities — 7.6% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Give safety information and trip recommendations tailored to current conditions and each visitor's stated plans — 6.7% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Log visitor questions, incidents and concerns to identify information gaps and revise visitor messaging — 5.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Check visitor information from automated or online sources against current site conditions before it is posted or repeated to visitors — 5.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Assign recreation opportunity classes to a planning area from setting characteristics, access and existing use — 5.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Coordinate a medical evacuation from a remote site, passing patient condition, location and landing or access information to responders — 5.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Test field radios and satellite devices for a work area before deployment, programming channels and confirming coverage at key locations — 5.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Verify remote-sensed or analytics-flagged tree risk scores on the ground, recording each override with the field reason — 5.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Answer public questions about an uncertain environmental risk at a meeting or by phone using the current message map — 5.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Conduct a job hazard analysis at the actual work site before field activity begins, naming each hazard present and its control — 5.3% *(needed at entry)*
- Designate motorized and non-motorized routes in a travel plan that separate conflicting uses and protect resources — 3.9% *(needed at entry)*
- Inspect crew first aid and trauma kits on schedule, replacing expired or missing items and recording the check — 3.9% *(needed at entry)*
